# The Oaks Ranch Barn Weddings

> Barn wedding venue on 100 acres of shady, Spanish-moss-draped oak trees in Green Cove Springs, Florida (Clay County, outside Jacksonville).

The Oaks Ranch is 100 acres of shady oak trees draped in Spanish moss and miles of serene trails in Florida back country. It is a beautiful, secluded setting to have your wedding and reception, with three wedding ceremony sites, a 4,000 sq. ft. barn with a/c and heat and the stable area with a lighted dance floor for wedding rehearsal, ceremony and reception.

## Venue facts
- Gated and secure 100-acre property; miles of serene trails
- Three separate ceremony sites with rustic seating (including the White Colonnades and the Black Pergola)
- 4,000 sq. ft. barn with a/c and heat; 3 ADA-approved bathrooms
- Stable area with a lighted dance floor for rehearsal, dining and receptions
- A/C bridal suite and groom's room with private restrooms
- Accommodates very large groups (up to 300 guests) as well as small, intimate groups
- 26 six-ft round tables and 4 nine-ft farmhouse tables available (chairs not provided)
- Spools, shepherd hooks, whiskey barrel bar, rustic cake stands, signs; curtains at the ceremony sites, stable area and main barn; decorative lighting throughout

## Packages (as published by the venue; confirm current pricing)
- 2-day wedding and reception package: $4,000 (the venue's specialty)
- 1-day wedding and reception package: $3,000 (same amenities)
